auth.signInDescription: We'll email you a 6-digit code. New here? The same code creates your account.
auth.codeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
auth.newCodeSent: A new code is on its way.
auth.passkeyDescription: Turn on a passkey and sign in on this device with Touch ID, Face ID or your screen lock instead of an email code.

errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
errors.expiredCode: This code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: That passkey didn't work. Sign in with a code instead.
errors.passkeyExists: This device already has a passkey for Kotsu.
errors.passkeyNotAdded: The passkey wasn't turned on. Try again, or skip it for now.

signInCode.subject: {code} is your Kotsu code
